title: Checklist sweep M3: action preflight and page bindings, AI data tools and MCP, federation and CLI (since 18.3.0)
body:
domain:devx#2 · os-support-ai · session_01WGufzjFj4aaaJk1VJLqRdC

Filing gate: ③ a task on the maintainer's word: epic #32022 "Ownership", the maintainer in the `qa#2` seat session, verbatim 「你可以再开一个 devx 座位，处理相关清单卡」 then 「相关卡立一个专题」; the epic's Milestones table has this seat card M3 once M1 lands (M1 #32019 closed 2026-11-10).

Blocked-by: #32020

Parent: the checklist epic #32022. Milestone M3. It waits on M2 because both write the same area files (one writer per area file, SWEEP.md).

## What

Author the platform-checklist items for the last three themes that landed after 18.3.0 (`83d7e4ae`), with the `checklist-author` skill and the six angles in `docs/qa/platform-checklist/SWEEP.md`:

- **Theme 6, action preflight and page API bindings**: `ActionSchema.preflight` and its panel in the param dialog; the row-table page block; api-bound elements re-reading after their own action; AI pending actions held for approval.
- **Theme 7, AI data tools and MCP**: `list_datasets` and `query_dataset` (service and MCP, under `data:read`); the dataset member vocabulary; `read_file` PDF and Word extraction with its budget and cap; the MCP tool-call interceptor; chat answers linking the filtered list they counted.
- **Theme 8, federation and CLI**: SQL Server and Oracle as federation-only dialects (connection form included); Oracle `RAW(16)` uuid lookups; `os deploy --dry-run` and `--json`; `os validate --target`; the package upgrade plan's `.custom` override advice.

## Rules

- New items carry `since: "v18.4"`. A declared-but-absent capability is a `status: "planned"` item, never coverage.
- Every item's `source[]` cites the files it exercises. Every item follows README.md "Item anatomy". An item that needs a credentialed external database states its fixture (`scripts/qa/qa-fixture.mjs external-database`, #32233); without one it is `blocked` with the reason, never faked.
- `coverage.json` is reconciled. `node scripts/check-platform-checklist.mjs` is green.
- Defects or doc drift go to `FOLLOW-UPS.md` per SWEEP.md. Security findings follow `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/security-findings.md`.

## File surface

`docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/*.json`, `docs/qa/platform-checklist/coverage.json`, `docs/qa/platform-checklist/FOLLOW-UPS.md`. No product code.

## Premise re-check

```bash
git log --oneline 83d7e4ae..origin/main | grep -ciE 'preflight|row-table|list_datasets|query_dataset|read_file|interceptor|oracle|sql ?server|mssql|deploy --dry-run|validate --target'
node scripts/checklist-select.mjs since:v18.4 --json   # none of the selected items covers themes 6, 7 or 8
```

## Done when

`since:v18.4` selects the new items for themes 6, 7 and 8, the checker is green, and the PR has merged.
